{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Exclude refunded orders and QA test orders (revenue == '999999.99')
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
qa_count = (completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
if qa_count > 0:
    completed_only = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Compute average revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
stratified_avg = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Extract and print the specific values needed for evidence
# Only print the exact values that will appear in evidence
print(f"average_revenue_email_loyal: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'email']}")
print(f"average_revenue_paid_search_loyal: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']}")
print(f"average_revenue_email_new: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'email']}")
print(f"average_revenue_paid_search_new: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'paid_search']}")
print(f"average_revenue_email_returning: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'email']}")
print(f"average_revenue_paid_search_returning: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'paid_search']}")
print(f"difference_email_minus_paid_search_loyal: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']}")
print(f"difference_email_minus_paid_search_new: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['new', 'paid_search']}")
print(f"difference_email_minus_paid_search_returning: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'paid_search']}")"}
